title: Editable Cycle Service Tool Wall Kit
description: Original S01 static wall-mounted service kit with a continuous backboard, two rear mounting cleats, two open-jaw wrench sizes and one continuous six-sided L-key. Each tool is a named independently editable mesh with its own centered origin, resting on a real small bearing shelf inside an open keeper bracket. The two rear cleat faces define the mounting plane; the local bottom is an installation datum, not a ground support. One kit, no separately counted wrench sizes. No tool operation, animated removal or structural load rating.
